press_cnt.value: Conde Nast Traveler — “My favorite Airbnb: A Dreamy Croatian Villa Overlooking the Adriatic”

history_origins.value: Roots reach back to the early 18th century; house built in the 1930s by three brothers and two sisters from local stone; lime burned in kilns near the beach (some still standing); cypress roof beams cut on the estate; folklore: fifty cypress trees planted at a son's birth; no electricity — horses, mules, donkeys; eldest brother emigrated to Argentina to finance construction

history_life.value: Upper floor was the family home; ground-floor cellars stored wine, olive oil, dried figs and carob; property is 48,000 m² (settles the size conflict at 4.8 ha / 11 acres)

history_villa_palma.value: 1966: Mato Metković, back from America, made it a holiday home named Villa Palma; latest renovation kept the original exterior walls against architects' advice — 'You preserved the soul of the house.' (quote shown unattributed on their page)

history_today.value: 60+ years of welcoming guests; run by the third generation; western bay of Molunat is one of the few remaining undeveloped bays on the mainland Adriatic; carob among estate produce

location_detail.value: Molunat, Konavle; 40 min from Dubrovnik Old Town; boat transfer from Dubrovnik on request; on-site private parking; untouched bay, no mass tourism

experience_extra.value: Beach has sunchairs and sun-warmed stone platforms; yacht trips reach hidden caves; fresh fish from local fishermen for the grill; Dubrovnik by sea docks at the Old Town port

provisioning.value: Grocery stocking before arrival, food delivery to the villa, fully catered dining; all-inclusive packages may include private chef, wellness day, and a full-day yacht excursion to Dubrovnik with a private guided tour; limited groups per season, weekly model in summer; car hire not recommended in high season; restaurants ~15 min drive + konoba 500 m

guide_in_villa.value: Chef from €400; catering from €60/pax; sommelier & signature cocktails on request; massage from €100 (min 2 h); yoga from €170; hair & make-up from €300 (min 2 persons); babysitter from €50; laundry €40/h; private transfers on request (Mercedes E — 4, V — 7); car hire on request; Jeanneau Prestige 34 from €1,500; live sax from €500; private folklore show from €500
